newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices unchanged on quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices unchanged on quiet market.

text.p: Danish bond prices were virtually unchanged on Tuesday morning, in quiet trade ahead of German April employment data. Turnover was expected to pick up later, boosted by the re-opening of the London market after Monday's holiday.
"If the (Danish) market rises a little on the German numbers then the central bank will come in as a seller at the long end," a dealer said.
At 0725 GMT the benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 traded at 110.25, up 0.01 point from Monday's close but off an earlier high of 110.31.
The 10-year yield gap with Germany was unchanged at 67 basis points. The crown was also unchanged, at 3.8095 per mark.
